# Only needs verify

Only Needs verify is left, or verify.md is behind. Since 1.167.0 verify.md behind is the `**Catch up first**` block at the top of Run next (see [verify-behind.md](verify-behind.md)); this entry is for Needs verify with no such block. The ending starts with:

```text
Run next:

`$crav1-verify-build-against-spec <slug>`
verify.md is behind, so the built tasks need to be verified.
```
